criticalRule: A 32x32 source cell is an address, not automatically an independently placeable 1x1 world asset. Runtime promotion happens at the connected-recipe level.

straightSouthFace.source: c2r7 crest + c2r3 repeat body + c2r8 foot
straightSouthFace.height: crest on host + max(N-1,0) authored c2r3 body rows + one c2r8 foot at host+N

roundedSouthWestFace.source: c1r7 crest + c1r3 repeat body + c1r8 foot

roundedSouthTerminal.height: crest host row + max(N-1,0) complete three-cell body rows + one three-cell foot row at host+N
